title: The Phoenix platform's static feeds (feeds host)
description: What a device reads from the feeds host: the catalog index, the update feed, the revocation list, the key files with their delegations. Each signed file has a detached signature beside it (<file>.sig: base64 of the Ed25519 signature of the file's exact bytes, then a newline). The device code that reads them: apps/marketplace/service/lib/catalog.js, services/updates/updatesservice.js, apps/shared/platform/src/{signed,revocations,rollout}.js. New optional fields may be added inside a version; none may be removed or changed (PLATFORM.md 5).

base64Key.description: An Ed25519 public key: base64 of its 32 bytes

base64Signature.description: An Ed25519 signature: base64 of its 64 bytes

rollout.description: A staged rollout: a device takes the release when its bucket, the first four bytes of SHA-256(seed + ":" + the device's own random rollout id) as a big-endian unsigned number modulo 100, is below percent. The platform only publishes percent and seed; raising percent adds devices, 0 pauses.

delegation.description:
The offline root key's delegation of an online key for one feed (OPEN-QUESTIONS Q45). signature: the root's Ed25519 signature, base64, of the UTF-8 bytes of "phoenix-key-delegation:1
" + scope + "
" + key + "
" + issued + "
" + expires + "
" (exactly these strings as they appear in this object).

keyFile.description: <feed>/key.json (catalog/v1/key.json, updates/key.json). Devices that pin the root use delegations (up to four read; two while the online key changes); devices that pin nothing use key after the user checks its fingerprint (the catalog only).

fingerprint.description: First 16 bytes of SHA-256 of the key, hex upper case, groups of 4

url.description: The RAUC bundle, relative to the feed file or absolute; served with ranges (resumed downloads)

updateFeed.description: <updates>/<compatible>/<channel>.json; channel stable, beta or dev. Format 2 is signed (<channel>.json.sig) by the updates key or a key its root delegated (scope updates); a device that pins either takes only format 2. sequence never goes down for a compatible and channel; expires is at most 30 days on (the publisher republishes before).

revoked.description: Builds withdrawn after release: a device that downloaded or prepared one drops it

reason.description: malware and security: the device removes the app and says why; legal and developer: it warns once and offers removal; none installs again

catalogIndex.description: catalog/v1/index.json, signed (index.json.sig) by the catalog key or a key its root delegated (scope catalog). build never goes down; expires 14 days on (republished every 7). Written byte for byte as server/marketplace Catalog::publish writes it.

accounts.description: Account types (Connections): server/marketplace README "Account types", apps/marketplace/service/lib/accounts.js

revocationList.description: revocations/v1/revoked.json, signed (revoked.json.sig) by the catalog's key (the same key, or a key delegated for scope catalog). sequence never goes down; expires 14 days on.

keys.description: Online keys never to trust again (a leak)
